Two Young Men Die in Separate Suspected Incidents in India

Two separate incidents involving the deaths of young men have been reported in India. In Patna, a young man from Rajapakar died under suspicious circumstances, and police are questioning his three roommates. In Ludhiana, a young man died in suspicious condition, with allegations that his friends administered a fatal drug overdose. The Ludhiana incident occurred shortly before his birthday.
